definitions.r: sqrt(area/pi) of the connected shadow instance, mask only
definitions.fc_sum_*: guideline 3.1 as literally written: centroid of the SUMMED soft-band energy of log(I_shadow)-log(I_free)
definitions.fc_mean_*: same, but mean power per band (divides out the fact that a 2D annulus at frequency f contains ~f times more DFT bins)
definitions.fc_floorsub_*: mean power with the high-frequency noise floor (median of bands above 0.35 cyc/px) subtracted
definitions.f50_floorsub_*: frequency below which half the floor-subtracted energy lies
definitions.*_raw: residual over the instance bounding box
definitions.*_masked: residual multiplied by a soft instance mask first, so pair misalignment outside the shadow cannot contribute
